name: Two-Dimensional Materials
summary: Covers atomically thin materials such as graphene and MoS2: their synthesis, extraordinary properties and potential uses.

topics.name: Graphene: structure, Dirac electronic bands and exceptional mechanical and thermal properties
Hexagonal boron nitride and other insulating 2D layers
Transition-metal dichalcogenides (MoS2, WSe2) and their optoelectronics
MXenes, phosphorene and other emerging 2D families
Synthesis: mechanical exfoliation, liquid exfoliation and CVD growth
Transfer, van der Waals heterostructures and twistronics
Applications: electronics, membranes, composites, sensors and energy storage
